{"id":2015102232,"question_id":3405,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month, 3 weeks","timestamp":1779942536,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/2015102232/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count the Number of Special Characters II","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int numberOfSpecialChars(string word) {\n        unordered_map<char , int>stupper;\n        unordered_map<char , int>stlower;\n\n        for(auto it : word)\n        {\n            if(isupper(it)) stupper[it] = word.find(it);\n            else stlower[it] = word.rfind(it);\n        }\n\n        int count = 0;\n        for(auto it : word)\n        {\n            if(islower(it))\n            {\n                if(stlower[it] < stupper[toupper(it)]) \n                {\n                    count++;\n                    stlower[it] = 0;\n                    stupper[toupper(it)] = -1;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        return count;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-the-number-of-special-characters-ii","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2035}
